use default
use System.Math

let connections =
    [(from = 0, to = 2), (from = 0, to = 3), (from = 0, to = 4),
     (from = 1, to = 3), (from = 1, to = 4), (from = 1, to = 5),
     (from = 2, to = 3), (from = 2, to = 6),
     (from = 3, to = 4), (from = 3, to = 6), (from = 3, to = 7),
     (from = 4, to = 5), (from = 4, to = 6), (from = 4, to = 7),
     (from = 5, to = 7)]

permutations(values: List[int]) -> Pipe[List[int]] is
    if values.count == 0 then
        yield LIST[int]()
    else
        for chosen in 0..values.count do
            let rest =
                values
                    |> index()
                    |> filter(entry => entry.index != chosen)
                    |> map(entry => entry.value)
                    |> collect()

            for tail in permutations(rest) do
                let whole = LIST[int]()

                whole.add(values[chosen])

                for value in tail do
                    whole.add(value)
                od

                yield whole
            od
        od
    fi
si

peaceful(pegs: List[int]) -> bool =>
    connections
        |> all(line => Math.abs(pegs[line.from] - pegs[line.to]) > 1)

draw(pegs: List[int]) is
    write_line("      {pegs[0]}   {pegs[1]}")
    write_line("     /|\\ /|\\")
    write_line("    / | X | \\")
    write_line("   /  |/ \\|  \\")
    write_line("  {pegs[2]}---{pegs[3]}---{pegs[4]}---{pegs[5]}")
    write_line("   \\  |\\ /|  /")
    write_line("    \\ | X | /")
    write_line("     \\|/ \\|/")
    write_line("      {pegs[6]}   {pegs[7]}")
si

let pegs = (1::8) |> collect()

if let solution = permutations(pegs) |> find(peaceful) then
    write_line("one solution:")

    draw(solution)
fi

let total = permutations(pegs) |> filter(peaceful) |> count()

write_line()
write_line("solutions in all: {total}")
